title: Community showcase submission
description: Machine-checkable shape of a valid docs/community/showcases/*.md front matter. A showcase is a written creation (skill, guide, tutorial, template, workflow, integration, bundle) shared by a contributor to promote this community. Author identity is the core gate: author.handle is locked to the submitting GitHub account, and proof links must verify authorship. Enforced by tools/scripts/validate_community_showcase.js.

date.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD. The validator also confirms it is a real calendar day.

type.description: Written creations only. Attendance/speaking material is not a showcase.

proof.description: At least one proof link is required (validator enforces). GitHub-hosted links are machine-verified against author.handle; published (non-GitHub) links are resolved and confirmed by a maintainer.

published.description: Published, non-GitHub pages you authored (article, deck, demo page, profile page). Each is link-checked and requires a maintainer to confirm authorship.

related_skills.description: Community skill IDs this content uses or showcases; each must exist at skills/<id>/SKILL.md.
